title: Bucks trading Giannis Antetokounmpo to Heat for haul of players, picks - ESPN
content: Milwaukee Bucks agreed to trade Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis to the Miami Heat for a package centered around Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel'el Ware, and first-round draft picks.

title: Wolves land LaMelo Ball in blockbuster 4-team trade with Hornets - NBA.com
content: Charlotte Hornets agreed to trade LaMelo Ball and Josh Green to the Minnesota Timberwolves in a four-team framework sending Naz Reid and major draft picks to Charlotte.

title: Sources: Clippers, Raptors in trade talks for Kawhi Leonard - ESPN
content: The LA Clippers and Toronto Raptors entered serious trade talks centering on Kawhi Leonard after Leonard and the Clippers reached an impasse on an extension.

title: Reports: LeBron James will play for team other than Lakers in 2026-27 - NBA.com
content: LeBron James informed the Los Angeles Lakers that he plans to play for another franchise in 2026-27 as free agency opens.

title: Report: Quentin Grimes to sign four-year, $60 million dollar deal with Lakers, ending his Sixers tenure - Liberty Ballers
content: Quentin Grimes agreed to a four-year, $60 million free-agent deal with the Los Angeles Lakers, departing Philadelphia as Los Angeles pivots around Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves.

title: Agent: LeBron eyeing host of teams, including Heat, Cavs, 76ers - ESPN
content: On the Game Over podcast, Klutch Sports agent Rich Paul listed the Heat, Cavaliers, 76ers, Nuggets, and Timberwolves on a whiteboard of realistic destinations for LeBron James.

title: Heat acquire Giannis Antetokounmpo in blockbuster deal - NBA.com
content: As the NBA July moratorium lifted on July 6, the Miami Heat officially finalized their blockbuster acquisition of Giannis Antetokounmpo from Milwaukee.

title: Could LeBron James really sign with Sixers? What to know about his ties to Mike Gansey and more. - CBS News
content: Reports examined LeBron James' offseason ties to Philadelphia 76ers leadership figure Mike Gansey and Klutch client Tyrese Maxey after Philadelphia traded for Jaylen Brown.

title: Raptors, Clippers put Kawhi Leonard trade on hold, pending end of NBA investigation - NBA.com
content: Toronto Raptors and LA Clippers placed their Kawhi Leonard trade on hold pending resolution of the NBA's Aspiration salary-cap circumvention investigation into the Clippers.

title: Pelicans 1st Half Highlights vs. Timberwolves | 2026 Summer League - NBA.com
content: Pelicans 1st Half Highlights vs. Timberwolves in 2026 NBA Summer League action in Las Vegas.

title: LeBron James picks Philadelphia as final NBA challenge - NBA.com
content: LeBron James agreed to a two-year, ~$8 million veteran-minimum contract (~$3.9M in 2026-27 with a player option) to join the Philadelphia 76ers alongside Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, and Tyrese Maxey.

title: LeBron James picks Philadelphia as final NBA challenge - Wire Reprint
content: LeBron James agreed to a two-year, ~$8 million veteran-minimum contract (~$3.9M in 2026-27 with a player option) to join the Philadelphia 76ers alongside Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, and Tyrese Maxey Wire.

title: Draymond Green believes LeBron James' Warriors history played role in decision - NBC Sports Bay Area & California
content: On The Draymond Green Show, Draymond Green detailed Golden State's summer pursuit of LeBron James and said historical Cavs-Warriors rivalry baggage pushed James toward Philadelphia.

title: James Harden agrees to 3-year, $97M deal to remain with Cavaliers - ESPN
content: After declining his $42.3 million player option earlier in the summer, James Harden agreed to a three-year, $97 million fully guaranteed contract (~$30.6M in 2026-27, third-year player option, 15% trade kicker) to stay with the Cleveland Cavaliers.

title: Phil Handy joins Sixers coaching staff, reunites with LeBron James and Nick Nurse - Metro Philadelphia
content: Philadelphia 76ers hired veteran assistant coach Phil Handy—former Cavaliers and Lakers championship assistant alongside LeBron James—onto Nick Nurse's coaching staff.

title: Sixers add longtime LeBron James confidant Randy Mims to front office - Inquirer.com
content: Philadelphia 76ers hired LeBron James' longtime Akron confidant Randy Mims to their front office as Executive Administrator of Player Programs and Logistics.

title: NBA strips Clippers of 5 first-round draft picks, fines Steve Ballmer $30M in Kawhi Leonard salary cap circumvention probe - Yahoo Sports
content: The NBA stripped the LA Clippers of five first-round draft picks and fined owner Steve Ballmer $30 million over salary-cap circumvention tied to Kawhi Leonard no-show endorsement deals.

title: Raptors acquire Kawhi Leonard from the LA Clippers - NBA.com
content: Toronto Raptors formally completed the trade acquiring Kawhi Leonard from the LA Clippers for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, and draft picks, followed by Leonard signing a two-year, $115 million extension.
